#### Salinity
Data from LeBlanc et al. salinity point data collected during 1999, 2000, 2004, 2009, 2011, 2014, 2018-2020 
To be interpolated and downscaled to 20m resolution
Need to find a validation dataset for this 

```{r}
salinity_1999_2020 <- read_csv("raw_bio_data/CHCRP eelgrass datasheets /Leblanc et al/Salinity_temperature_1999_2020.csv")

salinity_2019_no_NA <- salinity_1999_2020 %>% 
  filter(Year == 2019) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Salinity_psu))

res <- 20 
val <- 0

raster_extent <- ext(eelgrass_points_km)

# create an empty raster 
salinity_raster <-rast(
  extent = raster_extent,
  resolution = res,
  crs = "EPSG: 3725",
  vals = 1
)

salinity_xy <- salinity_2019_no_NA %>% 
  select(Long, Lat)


salinity_vect <- vect(salinity_xy, crs = "EPSG: 4326") # load in with correct CRS
projected <- project(salinity_vect,"EPSG: 3725") # then project to meters

xy <- as.data.frame(geom(projected)) %>% select(x,y)
v <- salinity_2019_no_NA$Salinity_psu


tps <- Tps(xy, v)
p <- rast(salinity_raster)

p <- interpolate(p, tps)
p <- mask(p, salinity_raster)
plot(p) 


# crop using land polygon 
land_polygon <- vect("shapefiles/clipped_east_coast_2021_bdry.shp")
land_polygon_projected <- land_polygon %>% 
  project("EPSG: 3725")

cropped_sal_rast <- mask(p, land_polygon_projected, inverse = TRUE)
plot(cropped_sal_rast)


# write as raster and save
writeRaster(cropped_sal_rast, filename = "./processed_evd/environmental_layers/salinity_raster_20m_res_2019_leblanc.tiff")

```

### Temperature 
```{r}
temperature_1999_2020 <- read_csv("raw_bio_data/CHCRP eelgrass datasheets /Leblanc et al/Salinity_temperature_1999_2020.csv")

temperature_2019_no_NA <- temperature_1999_2020 %>% 
  filter(Year == 2019) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Temperature_Celsius))

res <- 20 

raster_extent <- ext(eelgrass_points_km)

# create an empty raster 
temp_raster <-rast(
  extent = raster_extent,
  resolution = res,
  crs = "EPSG: 3725",
  vals = 1
)

temp_xy <- temperature_2019_no_NA %>% 
  select(Long, Lat)

temp_vect <- vect(temp_xy, crs = "EPSG: 4326") # load in with correct CRS
projected_temp <- project(temp_vect,"EPSG: 3725") # then project to meters

xy <- as.data.frame(geom(projected_temp)) %>% select(x,y)
v <- temperature_2019_no_NA$Temperature_Celsius

tps_temp <- Tps(xy, v)
p <- rast(temp_raster)

p <- interpolate(p, tps_temp)
plot(p) 

cropped_temp_rast <- mask(p, land_polygon_projected, inverse = TRUE)
plot(cropped_temp_rast)


# write as raster and save
writeRaster(cropped_temp_rast, filename = "./processed_evd/environmental_layers/temperature_raster_20m_res_2019_leblanc.tiff")

```
